s.t:
Our mission is to improve the performance of athletes and teams, which we do by engineering the premier technology platform for sport. We've been at the forefront of sports technology and science since 2006 - we don't just work in the sporting industry, we are actively changing its future. Our solutions are designed to help athletes and coaches "play smart" in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.
We work with over 4,600 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.

Our solutions include wearable technology, video analytics, and athlete monitoring solutions, and we are passionate about helping sports organizations at all levels to better scout, recruit, teach, and win.
WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY
We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products.
This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.
Based in Cologne, you will be a key player in the Engineering team working on the IMPECT family of applications. You'll contribute to IMPECT's internal services that power our data ecosystem, sourcing and managing data from external providers, ingesting and recording video content, and enabling large-scale event collection and annotation.

You'll also help build and evolve the systems that support our data collection workforce, including tools for task assignment, progress tracking, deadline management, quality assurance, and accurate compensation.

In addition, you'll develop database-driven tools that ensure consistency and detect anomalies, safeguarding data quality when integrating multiple data sources. IMPECT's applications are written in modern frameworks and provide exciting challenges.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll be part of a highly motivated team building and evolving the core services that power our data collection platform, forming the foundation for the applications we deliver to our customers.
We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance. Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.

Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
Build and maintain Angular web applications
Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications
Design and implement database schema
Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications
Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.
Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features
Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.
Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.

At least 5 years of software development experience.
Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular
Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin or Java.
Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema
Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications
Experience with Git code management is highly desired.

Very strong attention to detail.
Proven self-starter.
Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to prioritise and a "can-do" attitude.
Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team

We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability
We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!
Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch!

We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.
All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.
If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human, and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

s.h: What You'll Bring to the Team

s.t:
Culture & Growth
A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role, it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide.

We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together.

We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.
As a Sr. Embedded Software Engineer on the Starlink program, you will be solving challenges underpinning every aspect of the program’s growth. The areas you could have an impact on could include, but are not limited to:
Bringing up next generation space grade silicon, including in house designed system on chip and peripherals.
Develop software from the early stage boot loaders to business logic with an emphasis on deterministic, secure, and performant platform for all of SpaceX Linux based spacecraft and grounds-based components.
Infrastructure and tools to enable rapid development and testing of new features for all OS/platform features.
Our software engineers are responsible for the complete lifecycle of the software they create, including development, testing, and support.

Maintain and update in house branches of OSS software such as Linux, Buildroot, and u-boot
Support secureboot and runtime security of all Linux based satellite components
Maintain the spacecraft Ethernet network and connectivity
Develop, deploy and test spacecraft software update process
Support in-house System on Chip and peripheral through the life-cycle of the part
Support OS/Platform specific test infrastructure
Development and support device drivers for third party and in-house components
Be the first software team to receive new satellite components
Interface with Silicon, Electrical, and Application Software Engineers to bring hardware from prototype stage to on on-orbit operations

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or a STEM discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering; OR 7+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of a degree
Development experience in C, C++, python and/or rust

s.h: Linux Kernel Up streamed patches preferred
s.t:
Knowledge of networking and Linux networking stack
Good knowledge of computer architecture and modern secure boot flows
Experience with ARM embedded system
Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & continuous monitoring
Creative approach to problem solving, exceptional analytical skills and engineering fundamentals
Strong skills in debugging, performance optimization, and unit testing
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements
Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

Workday Application Developer – Remote Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Workday Application Developer Location: 100% Remote (U.S.) Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually Experience Required: 6+ years Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply.

We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position. Job Summary We are seeking a Workday Application Developer with broad expertise across Workday configuration, reporting, calculated fields, business process design, and Workday Extend application development.

The role spans technical configuration, custom report design, integration support, and lightweight application extension work, helping HR, finance, and IT stakeholders get more value from the Workday platform.

The ideal candidate combines strong Workday platform knowledge with practical engineering discipline and the ability to translate business requirements into clean, maintainable Workday configurations.

In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers.

The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production. Key Responsibilities Design and develop complex calculated fields, custom reports, and advanced reports using the Workday report writer.

Build composite reports, matrix reports, and dashboards supporting business decision-making. Configure and maintain business processes, condition rules, and approval routing across HCM and Finance.

Develop Workday Extend applications and PRISM analytics where appropriate, packaging custom logic in supported platform extensions rather than fragile customizations that complicate future upgrades. Build report-as-a-service integrations and support data export needs for downstream systems.

Configure security domains, role-based security, and segment-based security across complex tenants. Partner with HR, payroll, and finance stakeholders to translate requirements into Workday configurations. Develop and maintain documentation for business processes, calculated fields, and security models.

Support Workday tenant refreshes, regression testing cycles, and platform release adoption, validating configuration and reports against expected behavior before each move into production.

Troubleshoot configuration and report issues in production tenants, working closely with functional teams to isolate root causes, propose remediation, and prevent recurrence through configuration improvements.

Collaborate closely with integration developers on report-driven data flows, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards. Provide guidance on Workday best practices and configuration design patterns.

Participate in Workday community forums, brainstorms, and product feedback channels, contributing field perspective and bringing back valuable insights and emerging best practices to the broader team.

Stay current with Workday releases and platform innovations, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

Five or more years of Workday technical experience. Deep expertise in Workday report writer including advanced and composite reports. Strong proficiency with calculated fields across HCM and Finance. Hands-on experience configuring business processes and condition rules. Strong understanding of Workday security framework.

Experience with PRISM Analytics or Workday Extend. Familiarity with Workday tenant management and release process. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Workday Pro certifications. Experience with Workday Extend application development.

Familiarity with PRISM data ingestion and modeling. Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments. Experience supporting Workday Payroll or Workday Financials. How to Apply Would you like to know more about this opportunity?

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.
About the role As a Mid-level Software Engineer at Ledgy , you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.

This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers. Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

Teams we are hiring for:

Core Equity — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy ’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy ’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.

Workflows & Automation — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.

Reporting — Transforms Ledgy ’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.

Tax — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

Damit die Teams, die dieses Produkt entwickeln, jederzeit auf voller Geschwindigkeit liefern können, brauchen sie eine Plattform, die ihnen aus dem Weg geht – nicht eine, die sie ausbremst.
Als Platform Architect / Staff Engineer bist du Eigentümer der Core Platform Architecture – und du baust sie selbst, hands-on. Dein Design-Constraint Nummer eins: Die Plattform ist nie der Bottleneck. Du denkst in Self-Service-Capabilities, sauberen Contracts und klaren Boundaries – und du machst das Platform-Team zum Agentic-Engineering-Lighthouse der gesamten Organisation. Das hier ist keine Ivory-Tower-Rolle: Du setzt Richtung, indem du sie shippst.
Your Responsibilities Target Architecture ownen. Du formulierst, validierst und entwickelst die Architecture der Core Platform – inklusive der make-or-break Entscheidungen dahinter. Du bist die primäre Ansprechperson für Architektur-Ownership auf Platform-Ebene und entlastest damit die bestehende Architektur-Verantwortung von einer einzelnen Person.
Hands-on bauen. Du leitest und trägst persönlich zum Proof-of-Concept bei, der die kritischen Hypothesen validiert – und danach zu den Platform Services selbst. Du bist Builder, nicht nur Designer.
Platform as a Product. Du designst Services als Self-Service-Capabilities, die Module-Teams unblocked halten. Thinnest viable Platform beats Gold-Plating, immer.
Contracts & Standards setzen und schützen. Du definierst und sicherst die Contracts zwischen Plattform und Module-Teams: APIs, Boundaries, Non-Functional Requirements – und sorgst dafür, dass sie eingehalten werden.
Agentic-First von Tag eins. Du etablierst disziplinierte Agentic-Engineering-Practices im Platform-Team und machst es zur Referenz für die gesamte Engineering-Organisation.
Lead by Example. Du inspirierst dein Team mit einem Platform-First-Mindset. Deine Teammitglieder wachsen, weil sie dir zuschauen – und weil du die Standards, die du setzt, selbst lebst.
Alignment mit dem Architect. Du arbeitest eng mit dem bestehenden Architect zusammen, um übergreifende Architektur-Entscheidungen abzustimmen und zu validieren.
Dein Profil Must-haves
Hands-on Builder mit starkem Track Record. Du hast Plattformen oder Services at scale architektiert und gebaut – und du codest noch. Kein reiner Architecture-by-PowerPoint-Hintergrund.
Platform-as-a-Product-Instinct. Du hast Self-Service-Plattformen gebaut, die andere Teams schneller gemacht haben. Du weißt, wie Plattformen zum Bottleneck werden – und designst aktiv dagegen. Interne Teams sind für dich echte Kunden.
Sound Engineering Practices. Testing, Contracts, Observability, CI/CD, klare Boundaries – und das Urteilsvermögen, welche Non-Functional Requirements tatsächlich zählen.
Genuine Motivation für Agentic Engineering. Du willst Agentic-First mit Disziplin bauen, nicht mit Hype – und du willst es für andere modellieren.

Data platform. Pipelines on Dagster, time-series storage in QuestDB, and ingestion from the real world in all its mess: industrial CSV exports, biosignal formats such as EEG, EMG, and IMU, and public APIs of famously variable reliability, ENTSO-E being the canonical example.
Live operations. Keep our partner deployments observable and reliable, and make incidents boring.
Tooling. Build the internal tools that let a team of six move like a team of twenty.
Growth path. As you learn the system, work your way into the CLS core itself: the distributed runtime and the engineering of a system that never stops learning. We will actively support that path.

A computer science degree, ideally an MSc, and roughly two to six years of hands-on software development. An outstanding recent MSc with substantial real project work also qualifies.
Production experience in at least one modern stack. Our codebase is Python; if yours was Java, Kotlin, or TypeScript, we expect you to become excellent in Python quickly, and we have seen strong engineers do exactly that.
Comfort with Linux, Docker, and cloud infrastructure.
Familiarity with distributed systems and streaming data, or the appetite to build it fast. We run an actor mesh on Ray, and hands-on experience with Ray or a comparable framework sets you apart.
Evidence of drive beyond the day job: a side project you shipped, an award, an open-source contribution, a community you built. We care about this more than about any single framework on your list.
Equity through our VSOP. We want owners.

Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale.
We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales.
Our Stack
Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our TaskTiger scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis.

The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters.

We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented public API that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools.
We love open sourcing our code and ideas on our GitHub and on The Making of Close , our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like SocketShark , TaskTiger , LimitLion and ciso8601 .
AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting.
Our Teams
When you apply, you’ll have an opportunity to highlight the team that appeals to you the most. We’ll do our best to honor this preference, but we'll also be evaluating skillset fit and the needs of the business.
One thing to know up front: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close - this team is where you’ll start, but over time you’ll likely have the opportunity to work on many different projects.
The work splits roughly like this. Pick the team that excites you most:
Agents. Build Close’s agentic platform and customer-facing AI experiences. Voice Agents, Custom Agents, and Ask Chloe are already in flight. You’d work on the shared intelligence and orchestration layer that powers AI-driven processes across the product. That includes the ecosystem around our APIs and MCP surface, which enables external agents like Claude and ChatGPT to operate Close. This team is pushing deeper into applied AI, retrieval, and agent infrastructure more than ever before.
Communications. Own the voice, SMS, and email infrastructure powering Close — Twilio, WebRTC, WebSockets, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, and more. You’ll help build our voice, messaging, and conversational AI agents while scaling real-time AI across calls, email, and calendar sync infrastructure.
CRM. Build the structured context layer that humans and agents both depend on. We're rebuilding the data model so it flexes with real businesses, making the CRM agent-ready (retrieval, traversal, action coverage through MCP and our public API), and shipping the next generation of AI-native CRM features (AI Enrich, Autofill, AI Search). Operating on billions of Mongo documents with Elasticsearch underneath.
Growth. Run the experiments and own the billing infrastructure that turn trials into paid customers. Stripe metered billing, AI credit top-ups, the activation and conversion funnel, and the team's biggest bet right now: agentic onboarding (an agent that walks new customers through setup, configuration, and first comms). Hypothesis-driven, metric-first.
You Are
A seasoned engineer. Python is our backbone, but perhaps you’ve worked across Go, Rust, or TypeScript. You pick the right tool for the problem rather than retreating to what you know. You’ve seen a variety of problems, can collaborate and self-direct.
Building AI. You've shipped LLM-backed features for real users and have a POV on where they're trustworthy, where they fall over, and how to get them production-ready when customers bet revenue on the output. We use Pydantic, Temporal, LangFuse, and other modern AI infrastructure tooling to power our agent platform.
Working with AI in your day-to-day. You use AI tools in your own workflow to ship faster, write tighter code, and reason about unfamiliar parts of the codebase. We fund the use of AI tools (Claude Code, Codex and other best-in-class developer tools) and treat learning and experimentation as part of the work.
A builder first. You’d rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship.
Opinionated about API design for modern software. You've shipped internet-facing APIs and you think about who's on the other end - apps, agents, humans poking around in docs - and what each of them needs.
Battle-tested. You've debugged incidents where latency budgets didn't hold, owned a system everyone else relied on, or carried a pager for something with real customer impact.

**Développement de plateformes :**

* Planifier et exploiter des services et systèmes serveurs

Mit reibungslosen Prozessen, innovativen Technologien und nachhaltigen Lösungen helfen wir unseren Kunden, ihre Ziele zu erreichen.

Hier entwickeln und produzieren wir mit mehr als 700 Mitarbeitenden innovative, kundenspezifische Verpackungs- und Handling-Systeme für anspruchsvolle Hochleistungsanwendungen.
## Stellenbeschreibung ##
**Dieses Praktikum kann alternativ auch als Abschlussarbeit durchgeführt werden.** Folgende Aufgaben bilden deine Schwerpunkte:
* Du entwickelst ein Web-Frontend zur Anzeige von Prozesswerten (z.B. mit Angular).
* Zudem konzipierst du kleinere Backends zur Datenverwaltung neu (z.B. mit Python).
* Gemeinsam mit dem UX-Team sorgst du für eine intuitive Bedienung unserer Maschinen und trägst zur Verbesserung der Nutzerfreundlichkeit bei.
* Du entwickelst innovative Lösungen und testest diese auf mobilen Endgeräten.
* Ausserdem analysierst du Daten aus Datenbanken und erstellst Berichte über die Datenqualität oder verbesserst Aufzeichnungsmethoden. Nach der Klassifizierung der Daten können verschiedene Lernverfahren untersucht werden.
* Zusätzlich untersuchst du den gezielten Einsatz von AI-Tools zur Effizienzsteigerung im Entwicklungsprozess und dokumentierst deine Erkenntnisse.
## Qualifikationen ##
* Du absolvierst ein Bachelor- oder Masterstudium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, KI, Software Engineering, Statistik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

* Mit den gängigen MS-Office-Programmen kannst du sicher umgehen. Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von Webapplikationen sind ein zusätzliches Plus.
* Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
* Deine strukturierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise hilft dir dabei, die beschriebenen Aufgabeninhalte zielgerichtet durchzuführen.

s.h: C O R E R E S P O N S I B I L I T I E S
s.t:
The Senior Software Engineer — .NET / Integration / Automation will serve as a hands-on technical contributor within Banner Solutions ' Chief Digital Officer organization, working directly with the Systems Architect to build and maintain the integrations, automation workflows, and AI-powered systems that run Banner's operations.
Reporting directly to the Systems Architect, this role is part of the CDO organization and operates across multiple platforms and business functions. The Senior Software Engineer will take architectural direction and independently carry substantial features or integrations through to completion.
This is not a ticket-driven role. The ideal candidate takes a well-framed problem, asks the right questions, makes the technical decisions that are theirs to make, and delivers working software — pulling the Systems Architect back in at the decision points that actually matter.
Integration & Systems Development
Build and maintain integration workflows connecting core platforms including P21 (ERP), Salesforce, Akeneo (PIM), Algolia, and Canals.ai — "make these three systems work together reliably" is a common problem here
Design and implement APIs, background jobs, and automation pipelines that handle real transactional volume reliably
Debug across system boundaries — trace problems through multiple systems rather than stopping at the code immediately in front of you
Ensure integrations perform well, fail gracefully, and are maintainable by the team over time
Write code with good testing instincts: how do we prove this works, what happens when it fails, and what edge cases are we missing?
AI-Augmented Development
Build integrations against LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar — to power Banner's automation initiatives in areas including order processing, customer communications, and purchasing operations
Apply AI development tools fluently as part of daily work: to move faster, explore approaches, and think more thoroughly — while applying independent engineering judgment to what the tools produce
Contribute to automation workflows that reduce manual labor and improve operational consistency across Banner's distribution business
Technical Ownership & Judgment
Receive architectural direction from the Systems Architect and independently drive significant features or integrations through to completion
When something unexpected surfaces: investigate it, determine root cause, make the call if it's yours to make, and bring a clear recommendation back if it's architectural or business-related
Make normal technical decisions without asking permission — and recognize when a decision has crossed into territory that needs a conversation
Take business problems that aren't perfectly specified and turn them into working software, asking the questions that matter rather than waiting for a complete ticket

The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering production-grade AI solutions that meet complex business objectives effectively. This position requires a blend of expertise in modern AI technologies and software engineering, along with a passion for staying at the forefront of advancements.

Design, build, and operate multi-agent workflows and tool-enabled agents, implementing orchestration logic, state management, safety guardrails, and fallback strategies for resilient production pipelines.
Architect and maintain end-to-end RAG systems, covering document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector retrieval, reranking, and answer synthesis with a focus on quality, attribution, and latency.
Evaluate and integrate LLMs and GenAI services across cost, performance, and privacy dimensions, selecting the right mix of managed and in-house models.
Develop, version, and optimise prompting strategies; implement automated prompt testing and regression tracking to maintain output quality and reliability.
Define and own evaluation frameworks for generative outputs, including automated metrics, LLM-as-judge approaches, human evaluation protocols, hallucination detection, and drift monitoring.
Apply classical NLP techniques where appropriate and maintain awareness of data distribution shifts that could impact model behaviour in production.
Build and operate scalable, secure AI infrastructure on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, OpenSearch), following well architected principles and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Own the full deployment lifecycle: CI/CD for models and agents, testing strategies, observability, and rollback procedures.

Agent Orchestration: Production experience designing multi-agent systems with tool use, memory/state management, and fault-tolerant routing. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom orchestrators.
RAG & Retrieval: Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines end-to-end: chunking, embedding models, vector databases, retrieval tuning, and answer synthesis at production scale.
Evaluations: Strong experience defining and running evaluation pipelines for generative AI — automated scoring, human evaluation design, hallucination mitigation, and drift monitoring. LLM-as-judge patterns are a plus.
LLMs & GenAI: Demonstrated experience with foundation models and GenAI providers (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta). Comfortable with fine-tuning, instruction tuning, and prompt engineering at scale.
Traditional NLP: Solid grounding in classical NLP techniques (NER, text classification, intent detection, topic modelling) and good judgement on when to apply them alongside or instead of LLMs.
AWS Bedrock: Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock: foundation model APIs, Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails. Experience with Bedrock Model Evaluation is a plus.
AWS Ecosystem: Proficiency with SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, OpenSearch, IAM, CloudWatch, and VPC networking.
MLOps & CI/CD: Familiarity with model registries, CI/CD for ML, feature stores, canary deployments, monitoring, and rollback.

Python: Production-quality Python: packaging, testing (pytest), type hints, async programming, and clean ML pipeline abstractions.
ML Frameworks: Familiarity with traditional ML frameworks and fine-tuning workflows.
Experiment Tracking: Experience with Langfuse, Arize or Langsmith, or equivalent for tracking runs, metrics, and artefacts.

s.h: So, what's the role all about?
s.t:
You'll architect and deliver production-ready conversational AI agents that sit at the core of the business and directly fuel company growth.
These are live, scalable agentic AI systems, not experiments or proof-of-concepts, operating across sectors like financial services, healthcare, and commerce.
You'll have full ownership of the entire AI agent lifecycle, steering projects from early pilot through launch and ongoing refinement.
You'll collaborate directly with decision-makers at the world’s leading enterprises to tackle their highest-priority challenges with agentic AI.
The patterns and problems you encounter in the field will feed directly into the evolution of the platform, tools, and product roadmap.
How will you make an impact?
Develop agentic systems (agents) for large-scale companies that measurably outperform human operators in areas like retention and churn reduction.
Build agents that handle nuanced, integrated customer interactions, across a range of CX transforming use cases.
Design reusable agent frameworks adapted to the specific demands of different industries.
Drive design partnerships around new product directions, including agent architectures, self-service features, and generative development workflows.
Push the boundaries with emerging voice models and pioneer their integration into enterprise-grade deployments.
Set the standard for how AI agents are constructed, evaluated, and improved in live production settings.
Have you got what it takes?
Hands-on experience building and operating end-to-end production systems at scale.
With a natural builder's mentality with high personal agency, you default to finding solutions and shipping them.
Startup founder or early engineer experience is highly valued, you understand the tradeoffs between speed, quality, and ownership.
Proven technical problem-solving ability, particularly in rapidly shifting, loosely defined environments.
Experience developing or operating AI/LLM-powered systems in production is a major plus.
Working knowledge of the current AI agent toolkit: evaluation frameworks, orchestration tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering.
Familiarity with React, TypeScript, and/or Go is an advantage.
At ease working face-to-face with customers to unpack their problems and deliver practical solutions.
Prior experience in customer-facing or externally-led technical roles is a plus.
A clear, direct communicator who can be equally persuasive with engineers and executives.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making forward progress without waiting for complete clarity.
Able to balance competing priorities and drive alignment across technical and business teams.
What's in it for you?
Build AI agents that run in production at meaningful scale, not slideware or research exercises.
Work shoulder-to-shoulder with leaders at globally recognized enterprises and high-growth startups.
Directly influence the direction of NiCE's AI agent platform through the real problems you solve.
Operate with genuine autonomy and end-to-end ownership across the agent lifecycle.
Work at the cutting edge of AI agent development with access to the latest models, infrastructure, and research.

Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.
Role Description
Identity Platform is the trust root of Phantom: we own authentication, unlocking, onboarding/key generation, and the signing pipeline that every transaction flows through. This is a business-critical area where bugs can lock users out or put funds at risk. You'll ship TypeScript across browser, Node.js, and mobile runtimes (e.g., Hermes) to keep these foundations fast, secure, and reliable.

Own and evolve the signing path for every transaction in Phantom.
Build and harden authentication, unlocking, biometrics, and account access flows across web and mobile.
Ship passkeys (WebAuthn) and MFA improvements with a strong security/usability balance.
Own onboarding and key lifecycle flows: key generation/derivation, seed phrase flows, seedless registration, hardware wallet pairing.
Own sensitive key export/import experiences and related safety rails.
Write and maintain high-signal, non-flaky tests (unit/integration/e2e) for critical paths; ensure safe rollouts via monitoring and staged releases.

Must-have
7+ years of experience
Strong TypeScript skills; comfortable shipping code across browser, Node.js, and mobile JS runtimes.
Proven ability to build high-signal, low-flake test suites for critical systems.
Familiarity with auth concepts and common mechanisms (sessions/tokens, MFA/OTP, WebAuthn/passkeys)
Strong engineering fundamentals: system design, debugging, and production reliability.
Nice-to-have
Deeper experience with OAuth2/OIDC, WebAuthn internals, cryptography, or key management systems.
Web3/wallet or signing-flow experience.
Security- or money-adjacent experience (identity, payments, custody).
Rust experience (or strong interest in learning it).

¿Qué es?
Es un profesional especializado en el desarrollo, integración y adaptación de sistemas operativos embebidos (como Embedded Linux o RTOS) para ECUs (Unidades de Control Electrónico), con enfoque en la replicación y optimización de un Test OS en plataformas automotrices.
¿Cómo lo hace?
Analiza y porta el Test OS (usado para pruebas, diagnósticos y validación) de vehículos Gen2 a Gen1, adaptando su arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue.
Desarrolla capas de abstracción de software para garantizar la compatibilidad entre el Test OS y el hardware de las ECUs.
Integra funcionalidades clave como diagnósticos (UDS, DoIP), flasheo de firmware, adquisición de datos (logging) y monitoreo de salud en tiempo real.
Automatiza pruebas (SIL, HIL y a nivel vehicular) para validar el comportamiento de las ECUs y los componentes conectados.
Depura problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) y colabora con equipos multidisciplinarios para cerrar brechas de plataforma.
¿Por qué es crucial?
Su trabajo asegura que los sistemas embebidos en vehículos Gen1 funcionen con la misma robustez y capacidad de prueba que los de Gen2, garantizando calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de estándares automotrices (ej: ASPICE, MISRA C).

Lenguajes: C (avanzado +5 años), C++ (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), Python (intermedio 2-5 años), Bash (intermedio 2-5 años).
Sistemas operativos embebidos: Embedded Linux (avanzado +5 años), RTOS (avanzado +5 años).
Protocolos de comunicación: CAN, CAN FD, UDS (avanzado +5 años), DoIP, Automotive Ethernet (intermedio 2-5 años).
Herramientas: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape (avanzado +5 años), GDB, JTAG (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).
Pruebas automatizadas: GoogleTest, pytest (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), SIL, HIL (avanzado +5 años).
CI/CD y control de versiones: Git (avanzado +5 años), Jenkins, GitLab CI (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).
Firmware para ECUs: Integración, flasheo, diagnósticos (DIDs, DTCs) (avanzado +5 años).
Estándares: ASPICE, MISRA C (avanzado +5 años).
Visa (Obligatorio) - Viajaran a USA por el equipo de cliente

s.h: Análisis y adaptación del Test OS
s.t:
Analizar la arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue del Test OS implementado en vehículos Gen2.
Portar el Test OS a las ECUs Gen1 de RVT, asegurando compatibilidad con el hardware existente.

Desarrollar capas de abstracción de plataforma para facilitar la comunicación, control y monitoreo de las ECUs.
Implementar módulos de software para integración de diagnósticos, flasheo de firmware y adquisición de datos.

Integrar diagnósticos de ECU (DIDs, DTCs) usando protocolos como UDS y DoIP.
Implementar rutinas de flasheo de firmware para actualizaciones seguras en las ECUs.
Configurar sistemas de logging y monitoreo de salud para registrar y analizar datos en tiempo real.

Diseñar y desarrollar pruebas SIL (Software-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en entornos simulados.
Crear pruebas HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en conjunto con hardware real.
Implementar pruebas a nivel vehicular para validar el comportamiento del sistema en condiciones reales.

Depurar problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) en las ECUs.
Colaborar con equipos de ECU, eléctrica, sistemas, validación y hardware para identificar y resolver brechas de plataforma.

Trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios para asegurar la integración y validación del Test OS en Gen1.
Documentar procesos, cambios y resultados de las pruebas y adaptaciones realizadas.

Validar que las soluciones implementadas cumplan con los requisitos de seguridad y calidad del cliente.

Everis has a different standard for talent. We do not use years of experience, titles, or pedigree as substitutes for ability. We look for exceptional work, sound judgment, fast learning, ownership, and evidence of impact. It is not a lower bar. It is a sharper one.
We’re looking for an accomplished software engineer who has built real mobile applications and already has practical exposure to growth, experimentation, conversion optimization, or broader product work. This role requires both engineering depth and evidence that you can think beyond implementation.
Join Everis at a defining stage of growth. Help shape the product, influence the company we become, and grow with us. Work 100% remotely from anywhere, benefit from unlimited leave, and connect with colleagues at company-sponsored international retreats in some of the world’s most inspiring cities.
About Everis
Everis is a growing, remote-first software company founded by proven technology entrepreneurs Rob Rawson and Liam Martin, who previously built Time Doctor into an eight-figure global SaaS business. We acquire promising mobile apps and SaaS companies, invest in their future, and improve their products, technology, and customer experience.

Our ambition is to make Everis the best long-term home for exceptional software products—and a company where exceptional people can take real ownership, do consequential work, and grow with us.
About the Product
Pebble is Everis ’s growing, speaking-first language-learning app for iOS and Android. It helps people learn English, Spanish, and French through practical lessons, pronunciation practice, and guided conversations that get them speaking from day one.

The product is live and evolving quickly, with major opportunities across onboarding, habit formation, activation, retention, conversion, and new markets. Your engineering and product decisions will directly influence how well people learn and how quickly Pebble grows.
What makes this role different
Most engineering roles begin after the problem, solution, and ticket have already been defined. Here, you join the work earlier. You will remain a software engineer first, but you will also identify product problems, decide what to test, build the solution, measure the outcome, and use the evidence to determine what happens next. This is not a marketing role for someone who codes; it is an engineering role with responsibility for product outcomes.
What you’ll work on
Build, ship, and improve Pebble’s mobile applications.
Find friction across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and monetization.
Turn product questions into improvements, prototypes, A/B tests, and other useful experiments.
Use product and user data to understand behavior and decide what should be built next.
Define success measures, analyze results, and act on what you learn.
Work directly with our founders and product and business leadership.
Balance strong engineering with the speed required to test ideas and learn.
What you need to bring
This is a mobile engineering job first. You need to have built, shipped, and supported a production mobile app. We mean a real product used by real people - not just a demo or code sample.
We also need proof you've thought beyond implementation. Show us at least one of these:
Breadth beyond implementation. Direct mobile-growth or conversion work You must show meaningful evidence of at least one of the following: growth experimentation, A/B or split testing, conversion optimization, product ownership, building and operating your own software product.
Conversion optimization. You improved a real flow: onboarding, activation, a paywall, trial-to-paid, checkout, or another point where users dropped.
Core Stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment about reliability, maintainability, quality, and speed. Flutter/Dart, TypeScript/NestJS, MongoDB, or close equivalents; and App Store or Google Play subscriptions, paywalls, payments, or trial-to-paid journeys.
Production mobile engineering. Demonstrated success building and shipping production mobile applications using iOS, Android, cross-platform, or another credible mobile environment.
Product development or ownership. You helped decide what to build and why. You didn't just receive a finished specification. You can independently take production software from problem through implementation, release, and iteration.
Product-management-type work. You framed the problem, made trade-offs, defined success, or used evidence to choose the next move.
A product of your own. You built it, launched it, watched real people use it, and changed it based on what you learned.
What good looks like
Your fundamentals are solid. APIs, data modelling, testing, debugging, release practices, and production monitoring aren't someone else's job.
You can tell the whole story. What was wrong, what you personally built, what happened, and what you did next.
You cross boundaries when the problem demands it. Mobile, backend, web, data, analytics - you don't stop at the edge of your code.
You'd rather find out than argue from theory. You form a view, test it, and change your mind when the evidence says you should.

Compensation: $80,000–$120,000 USD annually, depending on experience.
Consequential ownership: your decisions will directly affect Pebble and Everis .
Direct founder access: work closely with experienced entrepreneurs on important product and company decisions.
Exceptional colleagues: work with capable, curious, high-ownership people held to the same demanding standard.
Room to grow: take on larger problems and greater responsibility as Everis expands.
100% remote: work from anywhere.
Unlimited leave: take meaningful time away when you need it.
Paid international company trips: come together with the team in some of the world’s most inspiring cities—to collaborate, build lasting relationships, and experience somewhere new.
